title: A member mentions other members in a room message, and each is asked to look
why: #365 section 7 (FND-C3b-EXPLICIT-MENTIONS-01): a member could not ask someone in particular to look at a message. Mentions are explicit actor ids on the message, at most five, each an active member; the author and repeats are left out. No words are parsed, nothing is inferred, no work is woken, nobody is notified outside the Studio and nothing is spent.

Only an editor or an admin adds or changes recipients; a viewer still writes, corrects and withdraws their own ordinary words with none, and can be mentioned. A submit without mentions has none; a correction without mentions keeps them; [] clears them.

Attention is bound to the message's committed revision (A36): a kept recipient still waiting moves to the new revision as one item, one who has looked is not asked again, an added one is asked, a removed one is not, and a withdrawal ends all. The same words with other recipients change only who is mentioned.

The recipient's need is opted into with mentions=1, so a reader that knows only A15's kinds never meets the new one. Each time a recipient is asked anew is its own occurrence with its own need id; markNeedSeen for a mention marks that occurrence on that revision seen; a seen for an older revision or occurrence answers 204 and clears nothing newer (V on #409). Readers with revisions=1 see who a message mentions, never whether they looked.

value.description: Members this message mentions (A37), by actor id: at most five, each an active member; the author and repeats are left out. Absent or null: none. A non-empty list needs an editor or an admin; a viewer writes without one. Nothing is parsed from the text.

The message's recipients after the correction (A37). Absent or null: kept as they are. [] clears them. A list that adds or changes recipients needs an editor or an admin. The same words with other recipients change only who is mentioned: no new revision, nothing erased or woken.
revisions=1 only (A37): the members this message mentions now, never whether they looked.

value.name: mentions
value.description: 1: also the messages that mention the person (A37): kind mention, ref.kind contribution, ref.id the message, ref.within `<revision>.<occurrence>` (the message's revision, and which asking this is: a recipient named again after being removed is a new occurrence); the id is `mention:<projectId>:<revision>.<occurrence>:<contributionId>`. Seen acts on that exact occurrence only: an earlier one's seen answers 204 and clears nothing newer. Without it, only A15's kinds, for a reader that knows no other.
